messages:
ravi: Heads-up: while testing the runtime quickstart curl sample on staging I got a 403 due to the Referer header pointing at an internal design doc (https://internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1/auth). staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart#auth :grimacing:
carol: thanks — which file and line? i can do a one-liner PR if it's just the header.
ravi: file is `docs/runtime/quickstart.md`, curl block includes:```
curl -X POST 'https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/generate' 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' 
  -H 'Referer: https://internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1/auth' 
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
carol: quick mitigation: swap referer to a docs-hosted path or remove the Referer header. rehosting a tiny KB snippet is ideal so examples stay self-contained.
doc-scan-bot: Link scanner: 1 broken external link found in `docs/runtime/quickstart.md` -> https://internal.redwood.ai/designs/api-v1/auth. Flagged 2026-03-21T14:02:12Z.
ivy: i can add a minimal `docs/kb/api-auth.md` with a short caveat and update the two occurrences in one PR (quickstart + examples/websocket-auth). will keep wording minimal to avoid i18n churn.
carol: please include a single-line changelog note and ping #i18n after merge. also assign to ravi for a quick staging smoke-test.
ravi: assigned. once PR merges i'll verify the curl returns 200 on staging.
ivy: PR draft will be titled "docs(kb): add api-auth note; docs: replace internal referer" and include both replacements. will ping this thread with the PR link.
carol: thanks — after merge run `doc-scan-bot rescan docs/runtime/quickstart.md` so the scanner clears the flag.
doc-scan-bot: Reminder queued: run `doc-scan-bot rescan docs/runtime/quickstart.md` after PR merge to clear alert.
ivy: aiming to submit PR in ~45m. :thumbsup:
